desc_short: Daytona International Speedway: wide tri-oval of steeply banked gray asphalt around a large flat green grass infield with a blue lake, one long multi-level grandstand with glass suites along the front stretch, no cars, no crowd

Arthur Ashe Stadium: large round tennis stadium around one blue hard court with light green surround, light fabric retractable roof on a dark steel superstructure on columns, red-brick base, dark blue seats
